en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Watch a documentary on bugs
Watch a documentary on robot manufacturing
Watch a documentary on pop stars

Insects, huh?
You sound just like Gonta.

It's good to explore your friends' interests.
That's key to understanding them better.

Let us watch an insect documentary together, 
so we both may understand Gonta better!

Shows like this make me think about Professor
Idabashi...
I hope he is doing well...

Being reminded of the professor has filled me
with renewed motivation!
Shuichi! Let's escape this place together!
What!?

Are you mocking me!? You know I gave up
on my dream of being a pop star robot!

I never expected this level of harassment from
you. I thought you were better than that...
...I'm very disappointed in you right now.

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
(*sigh*)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Keebo's inner thoughts...?
